ItemID: NA; Title: Partners; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Vocal duets sound appealing alongside the polished crossover singing I have enjoyed recently.
ItemID: NA; Title: PTX, Vol. 1; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Contemporary a cappella is less appealing right now than orchestral vocals and familiar melodies.
ItemID: NA; Title: That's Christmas To Me; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: My Christmas listening suggests some interest, but I would choose a nonseasonal album this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: 25; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Expressive vocal ballads appeal to me, but my stronger interest today is classical crossover.
ItemID: NA; Title: Carole King Tapestry; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Warm, melodic songwriting fits some of my listening, though it is not my first choice today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Hamilton O.B.C.R.       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I enjoy theatrical singing, but a rhythm-driven cast recording is not what I want right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Josh Groban; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Having listened to Stages, I would choose this for more of his expressive singing and orchestral sound.
ItemID: NA; Title: Duets; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The duet format interests me, but I would want to know the performers before choosing it.
ItemID: NA; Title: PTXmas; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Christmas harmonies could suit my seasonal listening, but I am not seeking another holiday album now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Glen Campbell: Greatest Hits; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Familiar country melodies could fit my interest in Golden and 747, but vocal crossover is my priority today.
